snippet.title: Last Call RE FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Last Call RE By Monty All Endings Horror Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Wylan's grandfather had always had a peculiar obsession with the Strange. Throughout his life, his grandfather would regale him and his siblings with tales of the odd and unusual. As he grew older, he brushed these stories off as just that- stories. Heavily exaggerated at best,   pure fiction at worst, crafted by his grandfather solely to entertain his beloved grandchildren.
